title: v1_83 / Thank you
content: ## Thank you Last but certainly not least, a big _**Thank You**_ to the contributors of VS Code. ### Issue tracking Contributions to our issue tracking: * [@gjsjohnmurray (John Murray)](https://github.com/gjsjohnmurray) * [@IllusionMH (Andrii Dieiev)](https://github.com/IllusionMH) * [@starball5 (starball)](https://github.com/starball5) * [@ArturoDent (ArturoDent)](https://github.com/ArturoDent) * [@tamuratak (Takashi Tamura)](https://github.com/tamuratak) * [@codespearhead (Code Spearhead)](https://github.com/codespearhead) ### Pull requests
